text: Standing in this exhibit, I am struck by a sense of curiosity and unease. The conversation about future relationships with technology—human, non-human, even animal—leaves me reflecting on the boundaries of family and kinship. I feel a mix of excitement and apprehension: how will these new connections transform what it means to belong, to care, and to trust? The people around me seem absorbed, perhaps pondering similar uncertainties. I am both an observer and a participant in this unfolding philosophical experiment.
